verdict: Boot image operation failed. The `WIMMount` service on the SMS Provider host is corrupted, misconfigured, or missing.
fix: On the SMS Provider host, reinstall WIMMount from the Windows ADK: open `<ADK-path>\Assessment and Deployment Kit\Deployment Tools\amd64\DISM` and run `WimMountAdkSetupAmd64.exe /Install`. Verify the service starts: `Get-Service WIMMount`. Retry the boot image action.
